gloss: to pass through, to go through

definitions.gloss: to pass through, to go through
definitions.explanation: To move through a place or along a route.
To successfully get through a test, inspection, or approval process.

definitions.gloss: to be understood, to get through
definitions.explanation: For a message or intention to be communicated successfully.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}を{通|とお}ってください。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {通|とお}す (transitive, to let through). Pattern: Xを{通|とお}る (pass through X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing or completed action. {通|とお}っている = 'is passing' or 'has passed.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{道|みち}を{通|とお}る (go along a road)
・{門|もん}を{通|とお}る (pass through a gate)
・{試験|しけん}に{通|とお}る (pass an exam)
・{声|こえ}が{通|とお}る (voice carries well)
・{話|はなし}が{通|とお}る (message gets through)
・{通|とお}り (street—noun; also: way, manner)

CONTRAST:
・{通|とお}る (intransitive): pass through
・{通|とお}す (transitive): let through, pass (something)

RELATED:
・{通|かよ}う: to commute (repeated passing)
